items.title: Nothing Shows Off Ear (note) AI Earbuds Ahead of December 8 Launch
items.summary: Nothing has published a detailed look at its Ear (note) true wireless earbuds and charging case, which can record, transcribe, and summarize conversations. The buds record calls while the case adds Talk and Record buttons; the full release is scheduled for December 8.

items.title: Honor Earbuds Clip Bring LHDC 5.0 and 40-Hour Battery to Open-Ear Market
items.summary: Honor launched its Earbuds Clip open-ear earbuds alongside the Honor 700 series, with a 5.6-gram C-bridge design, 10.8mm driver, and 24-bit LHDC 5.0 support. The buds offer up to 10 hours per charge and 40 hours with the case, and go on sale in China on November 27 at 449 yuan.

items.title: CNET Updates Its Best Open-Ear Earbuds Guide for 2026
items.summary: CNET's updated guide names the Apple AirPods 5, Bose Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen), Baseus Inspire XC1, and Shokz OpenDots 2 among the top open-ear picks. It also highlights clip-on and ear-hook options for calls, sports, and budget buyers, reflecting how quickly the category has expanded.

items.title: Soundpeats Air6 Pro Launches as a Budget AirPods Pro 3 Rival
items.summary: Soundpeats has released the Air6 Pro stemmed true wireless earbuds at $89.99, less than half the price of the AirPods Pro 3. The buds pair Bluetooth 6.0 with 11mm drivers, LDAC and aptX support, active noise cancellation, 12-hour single-charge playback, and 52 hours with the case.

items.title: AirPods Pro 3 Drop to $149 in US Black Friday Sale
items.summary: Amazon cut the AirPods Pro 3 to $149 in the United States, the first time Apple's current noise-cancelling true wireless earbuds have fallen below $150. The price is $100 below list and undercuts the $199 starting price of the AirPods 4, according to reporting published on November 26.

items.title: Xiaomi Clip Earbuds Launch Globally with Apple Find My Support
items.summary: Xiaomi has launched the Xiaomi Clip clip-on open-ear earbuds in global markets, with 5.5-gram buds, 11mm drivers, LHDC 5.0, and an IP57 rating. The case supports Apple's Find My network and triple-tap recording, while battery life reaches nine hours per charge or 38 hours with the case.

items.title: TechRadar Reviews the Tribit FlyBuds C3 Budget ANC Earbuds
items.summary: TechRadar found the $39.99 Tribit FlyBuds C3 deliver surprisingly strong bass and a comfortable fit for the price, with Bluetooth 6.0, IP55 protection, and up to 35 hours with the case. The review says active noise cancellation and midrange detail trail rivals such as the Nothing Ear (a) and JLab Go Pods ANC.

items.title: Samsung Slashes Galaxy Buds Prices in South Africa Black Friday Deals
items.summary: Samsung Newsroom South Africa announced Black Friday pricing from November 16 to 30, cutting the Galaxy Buds Core to R699, the Galaxy Buds3 FE to R1,799, and the Galaxy Buds4 Pro to R3,499. The campaign shows how true wireless earbuds are being used as headline discounts during the holiday sales season.

items.title: Noble Audio Astrid Review: IEM-Like Sound in True Wireless Earbuds
items.summary: Major HiFi praises the Noble Audio Astrid for a wide soundstage and precise imaging from a three-driver hybrid system with an 8.3mm dynamic driver, a 6mm planar driver, and a balanced armature. The review notes Bluetooth 6.0, LDAC and aptX Adaptive support, effective noise cancellation, and up to 40 hours with the charging case.

items.title: Omdia Data Show TWS Decline While Open-Ear Earbuds Keep Growing
items.summary: A data roundup citing Omdia reports global true wireless shipments fell 0.7 percent year over year to 82.1 million units in the second quarter of 2026, led by a 9.5 percent drop in mainland China. Open wearable stereo shipments reached 11.1 million units, up 12 percent, with clip-on models taking 61 percent of the segment.
